The consistent presence of these targets across different compounds implies a broader mechanism of action, possibly involving the modulation of protein kinase activity in HepG2 cells. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but the exact nature of the interaction remains unclear. The integration of these pathways highlights the importance of protein kinases in the biological response to these compounds, suggesting a possible role in cellular signaling or proliferation in HepG2.
